contractRunIdNote: The acceptance wrapper generates its internal target-contract run ID at runtime and never persists or prints it; no artifact records its exact value. A previously published acceptedRunId field was fabricated and has been removed during independent audit.

scenarios.description: Sales finalization fails closed with insufficient FEFO stock and rolls back.
Purchase finalization fails closed with status, sequence, posting, stock, and ledger all unchanged; the exact rejection reason is not asserted by the harness.
Intra-state sales finalization posts CGST/SGST, stock movement, ledger, and audit.
Accepted purchase finalization posts supplier ledger, stock movement, and audit.
Unreconciled purchase is blocked from finalization with no side effects.
Customer and supplier payments update balances and ledgers; invalid references are rejected.
Finalized invoice snapshot facts remain immutable after master-data edits and print snapshot fallbacks.

architectureCorrections: Fixture ownership collector resolves users through memberships and role_permissions through tenant-owned roles (fail-closed).
Acceptance runner uses a single ts-node CJS module instance for the auth adapter so the financial E2E test session resolves correctly.
Sales/purchase fixtures now carry gst_treatment, approved HSN/SAC catalog and GST rate rules, and per-line accepted accounting snapshots required by the current action contracts.
Disposal mode defers immutable-history cleanup to database-level target disposal; row-level deletion of immutable financial history is prohibited by assertion.
New campaign orchestrator creates a uniquely identified disposable target, runs the acceptance, and disposes the target at the database level.
